scope: Original compiled linear-resampler backend, zero low-pass order as used by VPX engine pitch resampling. Controlled source samples and scratch configuration/state; no original sound, clock, body or RNG state restored. This isolates resampling, not complete engine playback timing.
rateChanges: Explicit backend onSetRate calls use the pinned public ma_resampler_set_rate_ratio path denominator 1000, with controlled Float32 basePitch and requested pitch. Native config/timer fields and every output sample are retained after each change.
